mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% YoY triggers rate hike expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise signal monetary policy response to labor market cooling, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to predict negative returns in >50% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising PAYEMS growth signals strong labor market momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PAYEMS growth indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS growth positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1,150,000 units signals weakening housing demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as consumer spending declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST decline and INDPRO contraction signal broad economic weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to predict negative returns in >50% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), RSAFS above 12-month average signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.0% and RSAFS > 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
